Overview

Durrës is a city in Durrës with a population of 113,000. Albania’s second-largest city and main port on the Adriatic Sea, known for its ancient amphitheater, sandy beaches, and the Via Egnatia ruins. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year.
